I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random: the ticket is **#8841**.

That number comes from Tobias, who posted in #central-random yesterday at 09:27 that West yard Door 2 is "still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk" and that he'd flagged it to support on ticket #8841.

He called it "Tobias's dealer account" and never named Marrow Fieldworks, so linking the ticket to Marrow Fieldworks is my inference. It rests on the January handoff digest, which shows Marrow Fieldworks was Pree's dealer account and changed hands on 5 Jan 2026. I told Pree this and suggested she check with Tobias before the call if she wants to be sure.

I didn't look at any account files or ticket records. None showed up in the shared files I can check on her behalf, and I didn't use message search.
